metadata.description: Find as many words as you can in three minutes.

rules.title: How to play
rules.intro: Find as many words as you can in the {side} × {side} grid of letters before {minutes} minutes are up.

build.title: Building words
build.neighbours: Build a word by pressing letters one at a time. Each new letter must be next to the previous one: beside it, above or below it, or diagonally.
build.neighboursCaption: After <w>T</w> you can pick any of the letters marked in green, but not the faded ones.
build.validCaption: <w>CART</w> works: every letter is next to the previous one, including the diagonal step.
build.once: Each tile can only be used once in the same word.
build.reuseCaption: <w>NUN</w> doesn't work: there's only one <w>N</w> on the board, and the same tile can't be used twice.
build.length: A word must have at least {minLength} letters.
build.baseForm: Only base forms count: <w>cart</w> is fine, but <w>carts</w> and <w>carting</w> aren't.

controls.title: Controls
controls.undo: To remove the last letter, press it again.
controls.clear: The cross in the word field clears the whole word. On a keyboard, <key>Backspace</key> removes the last letter and <key>Esc</key> clears the word.
controls.send: When the word is ready, press Send. The button works once the word has at least {minLength} letters.
controls.blocked: If you press a letter that can't be picked, nothing happens.

scoring.title: Scoring
scoring.correct: The longer a correct word is, the more points it's worth. The points double with every letter:
scoring.wrong: A word that isn't in the word list takes away as many points as it has letters. So a wrong {length}-letter word gives {points} points.
scoring.repeat: If you send a word you've already guessed, nothing happens.

time.title: Time and result
time.end: You have {minutes} minutes. When time runs out, you'll see your result and every word on the board, with links to the dictionary.
time.choose: You can change the game length on the start screen ({options} minutes).
time.grade: Your grade depends on how much of the board's available points you got. The scale goes from “{lowest}” to “{highest}”.

longWord.title: Long word mode
longWord.text: In long word mode, one very long word is hidden on the board, and the rest of the tiles are random as usual. Every word counts, but since the points double with every letter, the long word is usually worth more than everything else on the board put together. When you find it, it lights up in gold at the top of your list.

game.longWordSearching: Long word ({length} letters): not found yet

results.longWordMissed: You didn't find the long word

menu.confirmResults: Are you sure you want to end the current game and see the results?
menu.confirmNewGame: Are you sure you want to start a new game? The current game will end.
